title: Broadcom signs multi-year chip supply deal with Apple until 2031
title_zh: 博通与苹果签署多年芯片供应协议直至 2031 年
summary: The semiconductor group will supply custom silicon components for multiple future Apple devices under a new agreement running through 2031.
summary_zh: 根据一项持续到 2031 年的新协议，该半导体集团将为未来的多种 Apple 设备提供定制硅元件。

title: Broadcom (AVGO) Extends Apple Deal Following A Fresh Look At Its Fair Value
title_zh: 博通 (AVGO) 重新审视其公允价值后延长了与苹果的交易
summary: Broadcom (AVGO) extended its long running chip supply partnership with Apple through 2031, sending the stock higher as investors weighed what fresh multi year custom ASIC commitments might mean for revenue visibility and AI exposure. See our latest analysis for Broadcom.
summary_zh: 博通 (AVGO) 将与苹果的长期芯片供应合作伙伴关系延长至 2031 年，随着投资者权衡新的多年定制 ASIC 承诺可能对收入可见性和人工智能敞口意味着什么，该股走高。请参阅我们对博通的最新分析。

title: JPMorgan, Bank of America and Other Banks Explore a Deal to Shake Up Payments World
title_zh: 摩根大通、美国银行和其他银行探索一项撼动支付世界的交易
summary: A deal for a card network could allow bigger transaction fees, but some bank executives are worried about backlash.
summary_zh: 卡网络交易可能会收取更高的交易费用，但一些银行高管担心会出现强烈反对。

title: Garbage Stock GFL Rises on Potential Buyout. Here’s the Math.
title_zh: 垃圾股 GFL 因潜在收购而上涨。这是数学。
summary: The stock has been weak lately, along with shares of other waste haulers, because investors want more AI in their portfolios and less garbage.
summary_zh: 该股以及其他垃圾运输公司的股票最近一直疲软，因为投资者希望他们的投资组合中有更多的人工智能和更少的垃圾。

title: Frankfurter Leben lines up offer for Athora’s German unit – report
title_zh: 《法兰克福生活》正在为阿索拉的德国部门提出报价——报告
summary: Apollo Global Management-backed Athora has been weighing the future of its German operation, including a possible disposal, after finding it difficult to expand the business.
summary_zh: 在发现业务扩展困难后，阿波罗全球管理公司支持的 Athora 一直在权衡其德国业务的未来，包括可能的出售。
